notes.title: First Week!!
notes.notes: This is our first week of early access. The team is quite excited.  We are already getting ready for our first update.  Due by Sunday of this week.  We have several issues we want to solve.  Such as the rift mode. We want to try and make it a more satisfying experience.   Improving the soundtrack is also an issue we want to look upon on.  Again thank you for your support.

notes.title: Community Update #3 - BOSS MODE!
notes.notes:
Tubular Rift Community Update #3

Welcome to the third Community Update for Boogie Down Games’ original VR racing game Tubular Rift! Each week we’ll be making a post about developments about the game, as well as highlighting the Tubular Rift community.

This week, we’ve added a new challenging mode: Boss Mode. When a race has been completed, the racer will face the boss of the track. More powerful, faster, and tougher than your rival racers, the boss of the track is a tough enemy to beat. Beat the boss, and prove yourself as the new boss of the track.

You can catch a preview of this new mode here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=miHW4-3kC4M

We’ve also fine-tuned the difficulty of some of the obstacles, as well as improved our cinematic cameras. Some more AI Racer work is also in the pipeline.

If you’re interested in being one of the first pilots to try out this new racing universe, simply add Tubular Rift to your Steam wishlist here: http://store.steampowered.com/app/717680

That’s it for this week! This is Bilal from Boogie Down Games, over and out!

========================================

Tubular Rift is a VR social racing game by Boogie Down Games. It features players choosing a ship to race against other players and creating their own experiences with other players. The game is currently in early alpha development.

notes.title: Community Update #2 - Initial CPU Racers!
notes.notes:
Tubular Rift Community Update #2

Welcome to the second Community Update for Boogie Down Games’ original VR racing game Tubular Rift! Each week we’ll be making a post about developments about the game, as well as highlighting the Tubular Rift community.

This week, we’ve crossed over 3,000 views for our Tubular Rift Early Access Trailer! We are ecstatic that so many people have been able to see the initial stages of the game. There is definitely more to come, more surprises in store for the community to experience, build, and compete in this next generation racing universe. 

You can check out the video here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1NTn-zUa5fY

Speaking of surprises, we’ve been working hard to make Tubular Rift a competitive game, both for multiplayer and single player. If you’ve seen earlier builds of Tubular Rift, you’ll see that there were actual CPU racers in the game. We’ve removed that to focus more on gameplay.

But after a week of intense work, we’re ready to bring BACK the CPU racers! 

Here is a taste of what you’ll see in the game: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=R2YtkxQXoT8

CPU racers are controlled by our systems, and will have a MUCH bigger role in the game as we continue to refine this universe. Stay tuned!

This is Bilal from Boogie Down Games, over and out!

========================================

notes.title: Community Update # 1
notes.notes:
Hello, and welcome to the first Community Update for Boogie Down Games’ original VR racing game Tubular Rift! Each week we’ll be making a post about developments about the game, as well as build the start of the community.

In this week, we’ve managed to fix a couple of user interface issues with the game as well as configure it to work with the Oculus Rift properly. 

Check out our latest video here demoing the VR immersive perspective inside the ship: http://bit DOT ly/2zfuR2K

We’ve recently submitted our latest version of the game to Steam so users can begin checking out the game. Once available, we’ll be sure to let you know it’s availability.

Our ambitions of the game are big. We aim to make Tubular Rift a universe of social pilots racing, competing, and discovering experiences together. Like all things, first come, first serve! 

This is Bilal from Boogie Down Games, over and out!

-Bilal
